title: Three-hop concurrent alias chain off a clocked counter
sourceUrl: internal: Kmila DeltaCycleEngine convergence regression test (handoff 2026-06-21 §5.4)
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: 8-bit synchronous counter whose value reaches the output port through three concurrent alias assignments: cnt -> a -> b -> c -> y. GHDL must show y incrementing every cycle. Kmila exhibits a stale/X output on multi-hop alias chains when the delta-cycle engine doesn't iterate to convergence per simulation tick. This is the §5.4 minimal repro from the practicas handoff.
